# pending-unknown-step-and-moves

Two records of the settler, chained to its head: one with a step this build does not know, one whose moves it does not know.

Laid over the state `pending`. Its bytes are written by hand in `tests/format/generate.rs`, each line sealed by toshokan 0.1.0 with `cargo test -p toshokan --test format -- --ignored --exact generate::fixtures`.
